title: SM ST5C
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time synchronous machine ST5C static excitation system with automatic voltage regulator, 10 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} sets the initial output voltage, {Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} sets the compensation resistance, {Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} sets the compensation reactance, {Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} sets the regulator time constant, {Regulator gain, K_R (pu)}, {Voltage regulator denominator (lag) time constant (first block), T_B1 (s)} sets the regulator lag time constant, {Voltage regulator numerator (lead) time constant (first block), T_C1 (s)} sets the regulator lead time constant, {Voltage regulator denominator (lag) time constant (second block), T_B2 (s)} sets the regulator lag time constant, {Voltage regulator numerator (lead) time constant (second block), T_C2 (s)} sets the regulator lead time constant, {UEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant (first block), T_UB1 (s)} sets the uEL regulator lag time constant, {UEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant (first block), T_UC1 (s)} sets the uEL regulator lead time constant, {UEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant (second block), T_UB2 (s)} sets the uEL regulator lag time constant, {UEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant (second block), T_UC2 (s)} sets the uEL regulator lead time constant, {OEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant (first block), T_OB1 (s)} sets the oEL regulator lag time constant, {OEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant (first block), T_OC1 (s)} sets the oEL regulator lead time constant, {OEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant (second block), T_OB2 (s)} sets the oEL regulator lag time constant, {OEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant (second block), T_OC2 (s)} sets the oEL regulator lead time constant, {Maximum regulator output, V_Rmax (pu)}, {Minimum regulator output, V_Rmin (pu)}, {Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} sets the oEL input location, {Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} sets the uEL input location, {Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} sets the sCL input location, {Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)} and {Thyristor bridge firing control equivalent time constant, T_1 (s)} sets the time constant for thyristor bridge firing. Values come from the instance.
